info.title: NEMLab shared API
info.description: Independently enabled price reads, operator controls, bounded grid imports and simulation lifecycle. Disabled routes return 404. Market dates use fixed UTC+10. Simulation bodies are at most 16384 bytes and decimal inputs are strings. The public GridReplay catalogue and replay API are not yet implemented; grid imports are operator-only.

post.summary: Submit or reuse a revision-bound scenario
post.description: No ingestion is triggered. Pending jobs return 202; terminal duplicates return 200. Equivalent normalised parameters and price revision reuse the same job, including failures; resubmission does not reset retries. No Idempotency-Key is required. Worker and API enablement are independent.

get.summary: Read simulation progress without private worker metadata

get.description: Returns original exact inputs/prices and unrounded double-based dispatch/accounting. Failed or unproven solver outcomes do not produce a successful public comparison. Currency is AUD; prices/cost rates AUD/MWh; energy MWh and power MW. No retention promise is made by this pre-launch contract.

operatorBearer.description: Locally configured opaque operator token; never embed in the public frontend.

DayCoverage.description: NOT_IMPORTED has null revision, retrievedAt and counts. Imported days have a revision and timestamp; valid + missing + sourceNull = 288. COMPLETE means valid = 288; otherwise INCOMPLETE. Retrieved time is an instant, not a market date.

day.description: One completed market day since 2021-10-01, using fixed UTC+10.

capacityMWh.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Physical/cost values in [0,1000000]; capacity >0. Semantic checks return field errors.

SimulationWindows.description: Minutes from midnight in fixed UTC+10; nonempty ordered charge then discharge windows. 1440 is next midnight.

day.description: Completed NEM day on/after 2021-10-01 with complete stored prices.
Completed NEM day on/after 2021-10-01 with complete stored prices.

chargeBelow.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Thresholds in AUD/MWh within [-1000000,1000000]; negative values allowed. Charge threshold must be below discharge threshold.

dischargeAbove.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Thresholds in AUD/MWh within [-1000000,1000000]; negative values allowed. Charge threshold must be below discharge threshold.

SimulationThresholds.description: Optional all-day price-rule experiment: charge when the interval price is strictly below chargeBelow, discharge when strictly above dischargeAbove, hold otherwise.

SimulationThreshold.description: Idealised same-interval price-rule replay over the whole market day. Ending energy may differ from initial energy; this is not a dispatch or forecast reconstruction.

endExclusive.description: Exclusive window end; 1-31 completed market days.

optionalFailures.description: Days whose optional (power) series fetch failed while core market data committed.

coverage.description: Per-day evaluated/missing counts and ramp outcome.

value.description: Exact decimal: extreme price (AUD/MWh) or ramp MW.
Exact decimal: extreme price (AUD/MWh) or ramp MW.

sourceRevisions.description: Pinned source revision ids per series/day.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor pinning the publication; pass as `cursor`.

manifest.description: Series list with pinned revisions, units and grid semantics.

payload.description: Materialised exact values: series -> day -> 288 slots (decimal strings or null).
